pkgmetadata.longdescription: Loads layouts saved from the Vial GUI (.vil files) into a Vial keyboard without opening the GUI: load, toggle between profiles or check which profile is active. Meant to be bound to a hotkey.

use.flag: Talk to the keyboard through dev-libs/hidapi's code (bundled, needs cgo and libudev) instead of /dev/hidraw directly
Enable desktop notifications after switching (--notify), sent over D-Bus
